/sys/leases/revoke-force/{prefix}.description: Revoke all secrets generated in a given prefix, ignoring errors.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: The path to revoke keys under. Example: "prod/aws/ops"

post.summary: Revokes all secrets or tokens generated under a given prefix immediately
post.description:
Unlike `/sys/leases/revoke-prefix`, this path ignores backend errors encountered during revocation. This is potentially very dangerous and should only be used in specific emergency situations where errors in the backend or the connected backend service prevent normal revocation.

By ignoring these errors, OpenBao abdicates responsibility for ensuring that the issued credentials or secrets are properly revoked and/or cleaned up. Access to this endpoint should be tightly controlled.

x-vault-displayAttrs.name: Do Not Attach 'default' Policy To Generated Tokens

token_num_uses.description: The maximum number of times a token may be used, a value of zero means unlimited

token_period.description: If set, tokens created via this role will have no max lifetime; instead, their renewal period will be fixed to this value. This takes an integer number of seconds, or a string duration (e.g. "24h").

token_type.description: The type of token to generate, service or batch

account_name.description: The name of the account associated with the key. Required if generate is true.

algorithm.description: The hashing algorithm used to generate the TOTP token. Options include SHA1, SHA256 and SHA512.

digits.description: The number of digits in the generated TOTP token. This value can either be 6 or 8.

exported.description: Determines if a QR code and url are returned upon generating a key. Only used if generate is true.

generate.description: Determines if a key should be generated by OpenBao or if a key is being passed from another service.

issuer.description: The name of the key's issuing organization. Required if generate is true.

key.description: The shared master key used to generate a TOTP token. Only used if generate is false.

key_size.description: Determines the size in bytes of the generated key. Only used if generate is true.

period.description: The duration used to generate a counter for the TOTP token calculation.

qr_size.description: The pixel size of the generated square QR code. Only used if generate is true and exported is true. If this value is 0, a QR code will not be returned.

skew.description: The number of delay periods that are allowed when validating a TOTP token. This value can either be 0 or 1. Only used if generate is true.

url.description: A TOTP url string containing all of the parameters for key setup. Only used if generate is false.

expire_time.description: Unix Epoch timestamp of the code expiry time.

generated.description: Unix Epoch timestamp of the code generation.

values.description: The values to set the header.

keys.description: Lists of configured UI headers. Omitted if list is empty

value.description: returns the first header value when `multivalue` request parameter is false

values.description: returns all header values when `multivalue` request parameter is true

reset.description: Specifies if previously-provided unseal keys are discarded and the unseal process is reset.
